headline: Pierrakakis: 120 Installments and Measures for Servicers to Be Voted Within October
summary: Greek Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis said bills on 120 installments and servicer measures will be voted in Parliament within October. A total of €1 billion has been allocated for emergency energy-crisis measures.
why: Debt repayment schemes and energy support affect household finances and the credit quality of loan portfolios held by Greek banks and servicers.
